[[File:AnalysisDroid-TCWs5BR2.png|thumb|right|200px|A Jedi Temple analysis droid]]
{{Quote|Those analysis droids you've got over there only focus on symbols. I should think you Jedi would have more respect for the difference between knowledge and wisdom.|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Analysis droids''' also known as '''intelligence droids'''<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''information droids''',<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> were specialized, first-degree [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They saw use during the [[Jedi Civil War]], where they helped solve investigations. Analysis droids were also used in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where they assisted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with their assignments.

Analysis droids were also prized by scientists and police forensic units, and were commonly found working in teams. Cybot Galactica's analysis droids possessed many components found in the technologically-inferior [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|PK worker droid]], and much of the framework was also used for the company's [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-6 battlefield medical droid]] that saw service in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
